note: Field Timer provides four @FieldFormatter plugins for the core datetime field type: field_timer_simple_text (Text timer or countdown; extends DateTimeTimeAgoFormatter; NO external library; setting type=auto|timer|countdown), field_timer_countdown (jQuery Countdown) and field_timer_countdown_led (jQuery Countdown LED) (both need the jQuery Countdown JS lib at libraries/jquery.countdown), and field_timer_county (County; needs County lib at libraries/county). Formatters are configured per field per view mode and stored in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.type + settings. No settings form/route. Medium cases create a datetime field on Article, apply a known formatter+setting to the default view display and read it back via drush cget; hard cases have the agent set a formatter on the view display, verified against the live entity_view_display component. Fixtures use field_ft_* on node.article and are removed on cleanup/reset.

evals.prompt: Which field formatters does the Drupal field_timer module provide, and what core field type do they apply to?
evals.expected_output: Four formatters, all for the core datetime field type: field_timer_simple_text (Text timer or countdown), field_timer_countdown (jQuery Countdown), field_timer_countdown_led (jQuery Countdown LED), and field_timer_county (County).

evals.prompt: In field_timer's 'Text timer or countdown' (field_timer_simple_text) formatter, what does its 'type' setting control and what are the allowed values? Does it need an external JS library?
evals.expected_output: The 'type' setting is auto (default), timer, or countdown: timer only renders past dates, countdown only renders future dates, auto renders both. It extends core DateTimeTimeAgoFormatter and needs no external JS library.

evals.prompt: The field_timer 'jQuery Countdown' and 'County' formatters need external JavaScript libraries to animate. Which libraries are they, and where must they be placed?
evals.expected_output: jQuery Countdown (v2.1.0) at libraries/jquery.countdown (used by field_timer_countdown and field_timer_countdown_led) and County at libraries/county (used by field_timer_county). The text formatter needs no library.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a datetime field 'field_ft_known' whose default view display uses a Field Timer formatter. Inspect the live view display and report which field_timer formatter id is applied to it.
evals.expected_output: field_timer_simple_text. In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ft_known component has type: field_timer_simple_text.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article datetime field 'field_ft_known' is displayed with the field_timer text formatter. Inspect the live default view display and report the value of that formatter's 'type' setting (auto, timer or countdown).

On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a datetime field 'field_ft_task'. Using field_timer, configure the default view display so this field is shown with the 'Text timer or countdown' formatter (field_timer_simple_text) in 'timer' mode (only past dates). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ft_task component has type: field_timer_simple_text and settings.type: timer. Set it via entity_view_display setComponent(...) and save.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a datetime field 'field_ft_led'. Using field_timer, configure the default view display so this field uses the 'jQuery Countdown LED' formatter (field_timer_countdown_led) with the blue LED theme. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ft_led component has type: field_timer_countdown_led and settings.countdown_theme: blue.
